operations.old: The local generator lemma applies to this actual reversed process and gives drift $\displaystyle \widetilde b_s(x)=-b(x)+a'(x)+a(x)\partial_x\log p_{\epsilon+s}(x).$
operations.new: Introduce reverse time $u\in[0,T-\epsilon]$ and $Y_u=\bar X_{T-\epsilon-u}=X_{T-u}$. The local generator lemma applies to this actual reversed process and gives drift $\displaystyle \widetilde b_u(x)=-b(x)+a'(x)+a(x)\partial_x\log p_{T-u}(x).$

operations.old: with bounded state derivative uniformly for $s\in[0,T-\epsilon]$
operations.new: with bounded state derivative uniformly for $u\in[0,T-\epsilon]$
